# Command R (03-2024)

Cohere · released 2024-03 · 35B params · cc-by-nc-4.0

**score 40.5** ±0.8 · #694 of 934 · from 14 benchmark results across 11 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://huggingface.co/CohereLabs/c4ai-command-r-v01/blob/760ddb6c203d87ebdbe3c9785b49570e1bf95585/README.md): Context length stated on the official model card.</sub>

<pre>
download         size  score
4-bit q4_k_m  ~21.5GB   40.5
8-bit q8_0    ~42.5GB   40.5
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m
ollama run command-r:35b-v0.1-q4_K_M
# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run command-r:35b-v0.1-q8_0
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
